methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Pre-Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $500K total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Chips & Semiconductors (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 12 same-sector peers exist in Chips & Semiconductors, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

methods.name: Public-Comp Anchoring
methods.skip_reason: target revenue not on file (private companies rarely disclose)
methods.rationale: Public Semiconductors P/S median is 21.4x across 3 tickers. Cannot apply without target's revenue.

data.narrative:
Photonium is a Pre-Seed-stage semiconductor company founded by Jennifer Song and Adam Mhatre that has raised $500K to date. The Chips & Semiconductors sector includes 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers, though the peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints for statistical median analysis.

Given data constraints, the Stage-Progression method is the only applicable triangulation approach. Using $500K in total raised as a proxy for pre-revenue valuation and applying a typical 2.5x Pre-Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier yields an implied valuation of $1.25M. Public-Comp anchoring remains unavailable absent revenue disclosure; the Semiconductors sector median P/S of 21.4x across ALAB, NVDA, and AMD cannot be applied without the target's revenue figure. Peer-Median analysis is inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-stage peers meeting the 3-datapoint threshold.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.06M–$1.44M, with a median of $1.25M. The key uncertainty is reliance on a single method. Photonium's true valuation will depend heavily on technical differentiation and IP strength relative to named peers (Cerebras, SambaNova Systems, Etched), neither of which can be quantified here. A subsequent funding round will provide market-tested pricing and should supersede this estimate.
